rules.title: San Diego source-of-income discrimination prohibition
rules.requirement: Landlords may not refuse to rent to, refuse to renew, terminate the tenancy of, or treat differently a tenant or applicant because of source of income, including rental assistance and housing vouchers. Income standards must count a person's entire income and the combined income of people living together or with cosigners.
rules.key_value: Landlords may not refuse or treat a tenant differently because of source of income, including rental assistance; 3x one month's rent damages
rules.coverage_conditions: Any rental-unit and tenancy in the City of San Diego; source of income includes rental assistance from any federal, state, local or nonprofit-administered program
rules.exemptions: Tenancies where the owner or a family member lives in the same building and shares a bathroom or kitchen with the tenant
rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for any person to do any of the following acts, wholly or in part, based on a person’s source of income
rules.interaction: Builds on California FEHA source-of-income protection and defines source of income more broadly; landlords keep the right to reject applicants for other lawful reasons.

all.unavailable: owner or family member resides in the same residential building and shares a bathroom or kitchen with the tenant

notes: Ordinance added 9-18-2018 by O-20986 N.S., effective 10-18-2018; text prints sections 98.0801 to 98.0806 only. No criminal-history or screening-timing rules in the text. File header lists SUPPLIED_MANIFEST_ID D075, but task says source_doc_id X028.
